en.tagline: Desert landscape design, installation, and xeriscaping for Arizona homes
en.heroSub: Desert Green creates landscapes that thrive in Arizona's climate, reduce water bills, and look incredible year-round. From design to installation.
en.about: Desert Green has designed and installed landscapes across the Phoenix valley for 11 years. We specialize in native plants, water-wise design, and low-maintenance gardens that work with Arizona's unique environment.

services.name: Desert landscape design
services.blurb: Custom designs that fit your space and Arizona's seasons. Drawings, plant lists, phased budgets.

services.name: Installation & build
services.blurb: Full hardscape to planting. Drainage, irrigation, stonework—we build it right.

services.name: Native plant gardens
services.blurb: Palo verde, desert rose, and native shrubs that thrive without excess water.

services.name: Maintenance & seasonal care
services.blurb: Ongoing gardens need ongoing care. We keep them healthy and beautiful.

reviews.quote: Designed a front yard with native plants. Gorgeous, and our water bill dropped 40%. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Robert H.

reviews.quote: They understood what we wanted and executed perfectly. Professional crew, clean work, great communication.
reviews.author: Jennifer S.

reviews.quote: Five stars for turning our boring yard into an oasis. Desert Green really knows their plants and design.
reviews.author: David C.

es.tagline: Diseño de paisaje desértico, instalación y xeriscaping para hogares de Arizona
es.heroHeadline: Tu patio transformado. Eficiente en agua. Impresionante.
es.heroSub: Desert Green crea paisajes que prosperan en el clima de Arizona, reducen las facturas de agua y se ven increíbles todo el año.
es.about: Desert Green ha diseñado e instalado paisajes en el valle de Phoenix durante 11 años. Nos especializamos en plantas nativas y diseño eficiente en agua.

services.name: Diseño de paisaje desértico
services.blurb: Diseños personalizados que se adapten a tu espacio y estaciones de Arizona.

services.name: Instalación y construcción
services.blurb: Instalación completa desde trabajos duros hasta plantación.

services.name: Jardines de plantas nativas
services.blurb: Plantas nativas de Arizona que prosperan sin exceso de agua.

services.name: Mantenimiento y cuidado estacional
services.blurb: Los jardines en curso necesitan cuidado continuo. Los mantenemos saludables.
